mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a rise in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand but a relative strength in residential investment, which historically precedes a mild equity correction over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST > previous 3-month average
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return exceeds +1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 3.5% while payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows at less than 100,000 jobs per month signals labor market tightness with weak payroll expansion, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate wage inflation and margin compression.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals a broad-based contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days unless offset by strong consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically different from the market median at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid reduction in the federal funds rate by at least 75 basis points within a single month signals an emergency monetary easing in response to financial stress, which historically coincides with a positive S&P 500 return over the next 20 trading days due to risk-on sentiment and liquidity effects.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in real personal savings (RSAFS) and a fall in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a precautionary savings behavior that typically precedes negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days as consumers delay discretionary spending.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS quarterly change > 2% AND GDPC1 quarterly change < -1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return exceeds zero.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.4 percentage points for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically precede negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days unless accompanied by a simultaneous decline in inflation.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly change < -0.4% for 3 consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL monthly change >= 0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase of at least 0.8% in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 6-month moving average signals a broad-based expansion in supply and construction activity, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change > 0.8% AND HOUST > 6-month moving average
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.
